//: @spaces/sdk — the plugin contract (docs/spec-plugin-sdk.md §3–§6; born by SPA-191, sdk-3). The one package a plugin author imports. It depends on effect, zod and — from sdk-4b — tldts, and on nothing inside this repo (D55; `src/package.test.ts` pins the list, and the eslint sdk zone fails any @spaces/core or @spaces/db import). Own semver: `version` here is SDK_VERSION (`src/version.ts`, asserted equal by a test), and a plugin's `manifest.sdk` range is checked against it at load.
name: @spaces/sdk
//exports: A build output, unlike @spaces/core and @spaces/db: `tsc -p tsconfig.build.json` writes ESM and d.ts to dist/, because a plugin bundle leaves `@spaces/sdk` as a bare import that the host resolves at runtime with plain node (sdk-11), and a published package cannot hand node a .ts file. Inside the workspace turbo's `^build` edge builds it before any dependent's typecheck, test or lint. `./build` is the plugin build helper (vite config + manifest.json emission) — node-only, and the reason vite is an optional peer rather than a dependency. Its source is `src/plugin-build/`, not `src/build/`: the shared eslint config ignores every `build/` directory, and the helper was going unlinted there.
